name: button
title: Button
description: Button with base / face / highlight / label decoration slots. Styled by a facet theme.
docs: The button has no look until a theme is active. This item also installs the base theme (themes/base.css): @import it from the CSS file that has @import "tailwindcss", and set data-theme="base" on an ancestor, e.g. <html>. For the skeuo theme: npx shadcn add @facet/theme-skeuo, @import themes/skeuo.css, set data-theme="skeuo". Needs a Base UI shadcn project (style base-*); it replaces your ui/button.tsx.
